deadline.value: No closing date is published. You apply through an open PhD position or by approaching a professor directly.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test requirement for PhD applicants is published on the pages checked.

supervisor.value: A Ghent University supervisor must commit to you before the application starts, and the supervisor opens the file in Oasis.
supervisor.quote: Before starting the application procedure, candidates must have a prospective supervisor at Ghent University.

also.quote: In both cases a candidate needs to obtain the explicit commitment of a UGent supervisor.
Your PhD supervisor will need to start up the application procedure: oasis.ugent.be

funding.value: Funding is not guaranteed. Candidates must find it themselves, through a scholarship they apply for or a staff position on a project.
funding.quote: Some funding agencies offer possibilities for pre- or postdoctoral researchers to apply for a scholarship or fellowship at Ghent University on an individual basis.

also.quote: Search for funding for your PhD.

entry_route.value: Open to master's holders. A four-year degree can qualify only if Ghent judges it equivalent, assessed case by case.
entry_route.quote: The doctoral programme is open to holders of a master’s degree or a degree corresponding to at least four years of study that is considered equivalent by Ghent University.

also.quote: Open to holders of a master degree or a degree of minimum four years of study considered equivalent by the university

notes: The Faculty of Engineering and Architecture publishes no separate PhD admission rules for this doctorate.
